description: This file defines a custom color picker dialog for Android, including a view for selecting colors via a hue wheel and handling touch interactions for color selection.

classes.name: ColorPickerDialog
classes.description: A dialog allowing the user to pick a color from a hue wheel; contains an inner class for the custom View.

classes.name: ColorPickerView
classes.description: A custom View that renders a hue wheel and handles touch interactions to select a color.

methods.name: ColorPickerDialog
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the dialog with context, listener, and initial color.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the dialog UI by creating and setting the ColorPickerView.

methods.name: ColorPickerView
methods.description: Constructor for the custom view, initializes paint objects, color array, and shader.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the hue wheel and center circle, highlights during interaction.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Sets the dimensions of the view based on constant size.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch interactions for selecting and confirming a color.
